organizeNoteId.label: Organize Note
organizeNoteId.description: The note that displays the Organize triage UI. Selecting it converts that note into a render note pointing at the Organize page; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

morningTime.label: Morning
morningTime.description: The time the Organize "Morning" button sets on a task's start date.

noonTime.label: Noon
noonTime.description: The time the Organize "Noon" button sets.

eveningTime.label: Evening
eveningTime.description: The time the Organize "Evening" button sets.

nightTime.label: Night
nightTime.description: The time the Organize "Night" button sets.

dimensions.label: Dimensions
dimensions.description: The classification axes notes are tagged with. Each dimension is one note label plus its ordered vocabulary of values. Adding a dimension here gives you a triage queue and a picker on the Organize page, with no code change. Value order is this list's order, so reordering never rewrites a tagged note. agenda@beatlink keeps its own separate registry for the Overview's derived display elements; the two never read each other.

label.label: Note Label
label.description: The note label values are written to, without the leading #.

writeColor.label: Also Write #color
writeColor.description: Mirror the chosen value's colour onto the note's #color label, tinting it in the tree.

triage.label: Triage Unassigned Notes
triage.description: Give this dimension a queue in Organize listing notes that lack a value.

actionableOnly.label: Triage Only Actionable Notes
actionableOnly.description: Restrict that queue to notes whose type is marked Actionable.

scaffoldsAreas.label: Scaffold A Root Note Per Value
scaffoldsAreas.description: This dimension is the one whose values each get a notebook root note.

key.label: Label Value
key.description: The stored value. Changing it orphans every note already tagged with the old one.

actionable.label: Actionable
actionable.description: Items of this value flow through the priority and start-date triage queues.
